control_point: Amendment or cancellation of settlement instructions after matching is governed by CSD rules requiring bilateral consent, and settlement fails accrue cash penalties under the CSDR settlement discipline regime; the control is the boundary between amendable and penalty-bearing states of an instruction.

citations.source_name: Regulation (EU) No 909/2014 (CSDR), Art. 7 - measures to address settlement fails

consequence_anchor.public_source: CSDR settlement discipline cash-penalty regime (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/1229)
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: basis-point daily penalties per failing instruction, scaling with fail duration; published penalty rates per asset class

commonality_rationale: Every CSD-settling institution processes instruction amendments and cancellations daily; the penalty regime applies market-wide and penalty statistics are published by CSDs.
